transcript.text: my oven fan keeps going after ive turned the oven off, been about 20 mins now. is it broken??

[Heading: Probably normal]
It is very likely not broken. Most ovens have a cooling fan that runs automatically after you turn the oven off to keep the exterior and control panel cool; it will usually stop on its own once the internal temperature drops sufficiently, which can take 20 minutes or more depending on how hot it was. However, if the fan is making a loud grinding noise, rattling, or hasn't stopped after several hours of being completely switched off at the wall, that would suggest a fault with the fan motor or its control. If it's just running quietly and you are happy to wait for it to cool down naturally, there is no need to do anything.
